spine.active_goal: Bring the prototype's Meadow (renamed from Garden) into the live Flutter app: per-user, per-year randomized meadow generation, the year / day-by-day / year-so-far UI, viewing past years, and hover or select on a flower showing its planted date, while keeping the current aesthetic and making it smooth with up to 366 flowers on macOS and Android. Spec it with the interphase prototype pathway, get approval, then dispatch with mitosis.
spine.next_step: Watch the mitosis run started 2026-09-29 (~/.mitosis/field-notes/meadow/run.zsh, log run.log, run dir ~/.mitosis/runs/field-notes/2026-09-29-meadow): when it exits, read the final JSON line; for any Lane that failed only at its commit or return line, set it held in state.json and rerun run.zsh --resume; then report the three draft PR links (Data, Scene stacked on Data, Page stacked on Scene) and gate verdicts to the owner. After the owner merges, run the live pass with integration_test/meadow_perf_bench_test.dart as a separately-identified profile APK via adb (never flutter drive).
